name: 白发路路
evolution: 呆小路 → 舞动路路 Lv.26 → 白发路路 Lv.40
description: 白色的毛发覆盖手臂和身体，随身携带的蛋散发出爆米花的香味。能从随身携带的蛋中获得勇气和力量，暂时还不清楚是什么原理。
descriptionEn: White fur covers its arms and body, and the egg it carries emits the scent of popcorn. It draws courage and strength from the egg it carries, though the exact mechanism is not yet understood.

skills.name: 防御
skills.descriptionEn: Reduces damage by 70%, in response to attacks.

skills.name: 种子弹
skills.description: 造成物伤，自己回复1能量。

skills.name: 示弱
skills.description: 自己获得萌化：速度永久+150。

skills.name: 击鼓传花
skills.description: 自己脱离，下个入场精灵继承自己增益。
skills.descriptionEn: Disengages; the next entering sprite inherits its buffs.

skills.name: 花香
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成魔法伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage to the enemy sprite.

skills.name: 魅惑
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成魔法伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage to the enemy sprite.

skills.name: 花炮
skills.description: 2连击，每次连击自己获得魔攻+60%。
skills.descriptionEn: 2 hits; each hit grants Magic ATK +60%.

skills.name: 碰爪
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage to the enemy sprite.

skills.name: 孢子爆散
skills.description: 造成物伤，1连击，每次使用后，本技能连击数永久+2。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage, 1 hit; after each use, this skill's hit count permanently +2.

skills.name: 践踏
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage to the enemy sprite.

skills.name: 盛开
skills.description: 自己获得全技能威力+30，应对防御：改为威力+60。
skills.descriptionEn: Gains all-skill power +30; against Defense: power becomes +60.

skills.name: 月光合奏
skills.description: 造成物伤，1连击，双方携带的所有精灵每有1层萌化，本次技能连击数+1。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage, 1 hit; for each layer of Fairyfication on all sprites carried by both sides, this skill's hit count +1.

skills.name: 光能聚集
skills.description: 造成魔伤，每次使用其他草系技能后，本技能威力永久+60。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage; each time another Grass skill is used, this skill's power permanently +60.
